galapagosHub.metaTitle: Private Galápagos Tours & Itineraries | Vermilion Routes
galapagosHub.metaDescription: Three private Galápagos expeditions of 6 to 8 days, Ecuador combos and 30+ activities by island. Naturalist guide included, from $1,790 per person.
galapagosHub.h1: Private Galápagos Tours with a Naturalist Guide
galapagosHub.subtitle: No crowds: your dates, your pace and a guide just for your group. Choose one of our three expeditions or combine it with the Andes.
galapagosHub.answerText: Galápagos is a year-round destination. For a first trip we recommend 6 to 8 days based on Santa Cruz and Isabela: giant tortoises, sea lions, blue-footed boobies and snorkeling in Las Grietas.
galapagosHub.factBestTimeValue: Year-round (Dec–May warm water; Jun–Nov more marine life)
galapagosHub.factHighlightValue: Snorkeling with sea lions and turtles
galapagosHub.toursSubtitle: All private, with Quito transfers and a naturalist guide on the islands.
galapagosHub.combosSubtitle: Andean volcanoes, colonial Quito and then the islands, in one trip.
galapagosHub.activitiesSubtitle: Filter by island, season or type of activity and add them to your trip.
galapagosHub.q1: How many days do I need in Galápagos?
galapagosHub.a1: For a first trip, 6 to 8 days: enough to visit Santa Cruz and Isabela without rushing, with time for snorkeling, hikes and giant tortoises.
galapagosHub.q2: How much does a private Galápagos trip cost?
galapagosHub.a2: Our private expeditions start at $1,790 per person (6 days) and include Quito transfers, hotels and a guide. Flights and the National Park fee ($200 per person) are not included.
galapagosHub.q3: Do I need to swim or be fit?
galapagosHub.a3: No. Hikes are easy to moderate and snorkeling is optional, with a life vest and a guide. We adapt the pace to your group, including families with children.
galapagosHub.finalSubtitle: Tell us your dates and within 24 hours we'll send you a private, priced itinerary.
